# Changelog

## 1.0

- Replaced the teammate HUD panel with world-space head markers using the
  supplied chevron artwork.
- Added teammate name and distance labels.
- Added yellow king, blue party, and green teammate role colors.
- Rebuilt the Mod Menu screen with Team, Cooldowns, and General tabs.
- Added marker scale, height, and maximum-distance sliders.
- Added Hoplite-only Apollo teammate tracking and HUD.
- Added teammate glow in duel and competitive modes.
- Added redesigned Apollo cooldown HUD.
- Added Mod Menu configuration with persistent toggles and layout controls.
- Added party-message pings, automatic party chat, weekly crate reminders,
  automatic pet selection, and Royale nick detection.
- Added Fabric builds for 1.21.11, 26.1.x, and 26.2.
